_comment: Workflows tracked by metrics/scripts/kpi_*.sh. Schema: each entry must have repo (owner/name), workflow_path (.github/workflows/file.yml — stable), suite (a key of the top-level 'suites' map; each suite is its own Slack table, in map order, titled by the map value; entries without suite count as 'pay'), label (human-readable row name, unique within its suite — suite + label key the row and the alert state; keep it ≤12 chars to fit the table column), platform (groups workflows for the bug-catches aggregate; keep it distinct across suites, e.g. 'kotlin' for Pay vs 'kotlin-connect', so suites never merge). Optional branch filters pass/flake/bug-catch runs to that branch (e.g. 'main', or 'develop' for SDK repos); omit it to count runs on every branch. Optional job_pattern is a Bash regex; when set, the conclusion is taken from the matching JOB inside each workflow run rather than the run itself — used when one job of many is in scope, including jobs nested inside called reusable workflows (e.g. pay-core's Maestro CD job lives inside sub-validate.yml which is called by sub-cd.yml which is called by event_release.yml, but the nested job is visible in event_release.yml's run-jobs endpoint).
